title: Amazon raised AWS' EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML prices by ~15% on January 3, saying the adjustment "reflects the supply/demand patterns we expect this quarter" (Corey Quinn/The Register)
summary: Corey Quinn / The Register: Amazon raised AWS' EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML prices by ~15% on January 3, saying the adjustment “reflects the supply/demand patterns we expect this quarter” — An anomaly or the beginning of a new trend? My bet's on the latter — I've been tracking AWS for a long time, with a specific emphasis on pricing.
contentText:
Corey Quinn / The Register :

Amazon raised AWS' EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML prices by ~15% on January 3, saying the adjustment “reflects the supply/demand patterns we expect this quarter”   —  An anomaly or the beginning of a new trend?  My bet's on the latter  —  I've been tracking AWS for a long time, with a specific emphasis on pricing.
